review.zh-CN: 派发任务的 Desktop 实例：进程在时不动，进程退出后交还任务

notApplicable.D8: Local processes and sockets only; no network path is involved
notApplicable.D9: The independent Desktop instance exists only on macOS
notApplicable.D13: The only new UI is a status label and reopen action built from existing task-detail components

rules.statement: While ARC's Codex Desktop instance is running, ARC leaves the instance and its tasks as they are, and ARC restarts or updates do not close it.

zh-CN.situation: ARC 的 Codex 窗口开着
zh-CN.after: ARC 不动它，也不动里面的任务，你随时在那个窗口里看进度、接手。ARC 自己重启或更新，也不会把这个窗口关掉

given.state: ARC's independent Codex Desktop instance is running and shows dispatched tasks, some finished and some running

when.action: Time passes, ARC Core restarts, or the ARC app updates

then.expect: The same instance process and its window are still running after an ARC Core restart and after an ARC update
Each of its tasks can still be continued from that window
ARC does not unload, release, archive or take over any of its tasks while the instance runs

rules.statement: When the process of ARC's Codex Desktop instance exits, ARC drops its own hold on the finished tasks and their subagent tasks within 30 seconds, marks each task handed back once its writer lock clears, and otherwise shows the remaining holder; a task still running finishes first, shown with a reopen action, then is handed back the same way. Closing the window while the process keeps running is not an exit.

zh-CN.situation: ARC 的那个 Desktop 进程退出了：被退出、闪退、ChatGPT 自动更新等。只关了窗口、进程还在的不算
zh-CN.now: 它跑过的任务在你的 Desktop 里一直只读，不能接着聊，也不能归档
zh-CN.after: 30 秒内 ARC 放开自己的占用，锁真正释放后标记“已交还”：父任务能在你的 Desktop 里接着聊，归档父任务时子任务一起归档。如果还有别的程序占着，ARC 显示是谁。还在跑的任务会继续跑完，跑完后同样交还；期间 ARC 显示“窗口已关闭，任务仍在运行”，可以一键重新打开窗口

given.state: ARC's instance holds dispatched tasks, some finished (with subagent tasks) and one still running; the main Desktop runs on its own app-server

when.action: The instance process exits (quit, crash or a ChatGPT app update), or only its window is closed while the process keeps running

then.expect: Within 30 s of the process exit, ARC holds no subscription or writer on the finished tasks or their subagent tasks
Each finished task is marked handed back once its writer lock clears; the main Desktop can then send a new message to the parent task and archive it together with its subagent tasks
A finished task whose writer lock stays held after ARC dropped its hold shows the remaining holder instead of handed back
Closing only the window while the process keeps running changes nothing: ARC keeps its hold and the tasks stay usable in that instance
The running task's turn ends on its own (completed or failed); ARC does not interrupt it
Until it ends, ARC's task details show that the window is closed and the task is still running, with a reopen action
The reopen action brings back ARC's instance showing that task
Within 30 s after the running turn ends, ARC drops its hold on that task and hands it back the same way

rules.statement: When the updated ARC starts, it checks tasks dispatched earlier whose instance process has already exited, drops its own hold on them without user action, marks those whose writer lock clears as handed back, and reports the holder of any that stay locked.

zh-CN.situation: 改动装好之前，就因为 ARC 的 Desktop 进程退出而被锁住的任务
zh-CN.after: ARC 启动时自动检查，放开自己的占用；能解开的标记“已交还”，还解不开的报告是谁占着

given.state: Finished tasks dispatched before the update remain held by the shared app-server after ARC's instance process exited

when.action: The update is installed and ARC starts

then.expect: Without user action, ARC drops its own hold on each such task
Each such task is either marked handed back, so the main Desktop can continue and archive it, or reported with its remaining holder

rules.statement: A task held by a process ARC did not start is reported with that holder and where it comes from, or with the shared app-server and an unknown client when only that can be identified; ARC suggests only steps that can work and never terminates or manages that process, which belongs to its own side, such as another computer's ARC.

zh-CN.situation: 锁在不是 ARC 启动的程序手里，比如你 MacBook 上的 Codex 通过 SSH 连着 Mac mini
zh-CN.now: ARC 让你去一个找不到的 App 里归档
zh-CN.after: ARC 告诉你是哪个程序锁的、它从哪来；如果只能查到是后台 App Server 占着、查不到具体是哪个客户端，就如实这么说。只给能做到的下一步，不强制结束它，也不替那一侧处理，那一侧由它自己的 ARC 闭环

given.state: A dispatched task is held by a process ARC did not start, such as a Codex app-server serving a remote SSH client

when.action: The control source or the task panel asks who holds the task

then.expect: The result names the holding process and its origin, or names the shared app-server and states that the holding client is unknown
Every suggested next step can be carried out; none points to a window or app that is not running
The holding process keeps running and ARC does not change its subscriptions

rules.statement: A follow-up ARC send to a handed-back task that the user has continued in the main Desktop does not take the task back and is not delivered; ARC reports that the user is using it.

zh-CN.situation: 任务交还后你接着在自己的 Desktop 里聊，这时 ARC 又要给它发消息
zh-CN.after: 不抢回来、不重复发，只报告“这个任务正在被你使用”

given.state: A task handed back after ARC's instance process exited, and the user has continued it in the main Desktop

when.action: A control source sends a follow-up to that task through ARC

then.expect: The task stays writable in the main Desktop
The follow-up input is not delivered to the task, once or repeatedly
The send result reports that the task is in use in the user's Desktop
